description: Blend-mode sweep (component): per texture set (s0 Tint, s1 Saturation, s2 Color, s3 Value, s4 NormalMapCombine, s5 NormalMapDetail, s6 NormalMapInverseDetail) a lower fill with the authored 16-bit fields A (RGB) / grey A and an upper fill with fields B / grey B in the set's mode, on eight user channels covering the formats RGB16, sRGB8, RGB8, RGB16F, L16 and RGB32F at upper opacities 1, 0.5 and 0.25 (04 section 3). Sets without a mode keep the empty stack.
